subset.argument_policy: Mouse events preserve Button, Shift, X, and Y as serialized FM20-style scalar metadata emitted by oxforms-core. KeyDown and KeyUp preserve the reducer's normalized key/modifiers/repeat/raw diagnostics; the smoke does not fabricate FM20 Shift for keyboard events. KeyPress preserves text, key_ascii_placeholder, modifiers, and mutable-helper metadata in dispatch trace; live MSForms.ReturnInteger helper mutation remains deferred.
subset.handler_event_reason: The smoke uses one generic VBA event as a carrier to prove OxVba RaiseEvent/WithEvents dispatch without introducing a forms runtime. Native FM20-named event procedures remain blocked by the OxVba gap recorded in docs/handovers/HANDOVER_OxVba_w005_fm20_event_raise.md.

dispatch_trace_requirements: Dispatch order is reducer effect order.
Target form/control metadata is preserved outside the VBA carrier event.
KeyDown and KeyUp dispatch rows preserve normalized modifiers and do not expose FM20 Shift until native FM20 event raising is implemented.
KeyPress records key_ascii_placeholder=65 as byref_or_mutable plus deferred ReturnInteger mutation metadata.
